top_signals.title: US Missiles Strike Across Iran After Houthis Announce Naval Blockade
top_signals.summary: U.S. missiles struck targets across Iran, reaching as far as its Caspian coast, on Friday after President Donald Trump vowed "major military punishment" for Tehran and its Houthi allies in Yemen for extending the Middle East war to a second major shipping chokepoint…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ‘Incredible work’: Ukrainian F-16 downs Russian fighter jet for first time
top_signals.summary: The kill, confirmed by the top U.S. general, is the latest sign of Kyiv's growing air power — pulled off by one of the oldest fighters in the sky.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Musk's bad week: Tesla suffers worst slump since 2022, SpaceX drops ahead of Starship test flight
top_signals.summary: Tesla shares plunged almost 18% this week after the company missed on earnings and turned cash flow negative.
